black := array(11, fill = array(11, fill = false))
row := 5
column := 5
direction := 0
dr := [-1, 0, 1, 0]
dc := [0, 1, 0, -1]
for: step < 300
    direction = if black[row][column] then (direction + 3) % 4 else (direction + 1) % 4
    black[row][column] = not black[row][column]
    row = (row + dr[direction] + 11) % 11
    column = (column + dc[direction] + 11) % 11
count := 0
for: r < 11
    line := ""
    for: c < 11
        if black[r][c]
            count += 1
        line += if r == row and c == column then "A" elif black[r][c] then "#" else "."
    println(line)
println("black: {count}")
